exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-22T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix mail-

exec card --actor batch-monitor mail send catalog-worker 'source scan completed'

exec card --actor catalog-worker --json mail recv
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/read.jsonl
exec card --actor catalog-worker mail recv
! stdout .
exec card --actor catalog-worker --json mail recv --all
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/read.jsonl

-- golden/read.jsonl --
{"id":"mail_00000000000000000000000000000001","sender":"batch-monitor","recipient":"catalog-worker","source_topic":null,"body":"source scan completed","created":"2026-07-22T12:00:00Z","expires":"2026-07-29T12:00:00Z","read_at":"2026-07-22T12:00:00Z"}
